verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM publishes its Developer API as an OpenAPI 3.0.0 document (67 /v1/ paths) in the official repository, downloadable as raw JSON. Every self-hosted or desktop instance also serves Swagger docs at /api/docs. The probe 404s on the docs site show only that the spec is not hosted there, not that it is unavailable. Missing for 10: a canonical vendor-hosted spec URL on the docs domain (all probed docs paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of using the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: AnythingLLM publishes its Developer API as an OpenAPI 3.0.0 document in the official repository (67 paths, all under /v1/)
You can find the API documentation for available endpoints on your instance at /api/docs
